integrity: Originality is restricted to inverse angle-spectrum identification using the limiting perimeter MGF. Prior local Poisson endpoint-gap theory is explicitly acknowledged; infinite assertions rest on the proof, not simulations.
scientific_limitations: The result reconstructs only the angle multiset from the exact asymptotic perimeter-loss distribution, not edge lengths, polygon congruence, or stability under finite/noisy sampling. Priority remains subject to independent historical review.
title: Random perimeter-loss limits determine the angle multiset of every convex polygon
